The [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Cruiser]] '''''Defiance''''' was a [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] and part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SW:XW" />

==History==
[[File:Defiance_TCG-GA_Mariusz_Gandzel.png|thumb|left|200px|The ''Defiance'' engaging TIE fighters]]
During the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] investigation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] and [[Breth Gart]] were temporarily assigned to the ''Defiance'' to aid in the training of new [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]]. In [[Bestine system/Legends|orbit]] over<ref name="SW:XWSG">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> [[Bestine IV/Legends|Bestine]],<ref name="SW:XW" /> the ''Defiance'' was [[Attack on the Defiance|attacked]] by the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Immortal/Legends|Immortal]]'' which launched two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma]] and [[Delta Squadron (TIE/sa)|Delta]], to destroy it, escorted by the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] of [[Beta Squadron (TIE/IN)|Beta Squadron]]. Though most of the ''Defiance''{{'s}} veteran pilots were away flying other missions, [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue]] and Red Squadron pilots, including Gart and Farlander, scrambled to the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser's]] defense. The Rebel pilots and the ''Defiance''{{'s}} [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] occupied the Imperial forces until the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser was able to jump to safety in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="SW:XWSG" />

During the [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuation]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] requested the ''Defiance''{{'s}} presence in order to protect the Rebel ships attempting to escape the Imperial [[Yavin blockade]] to hyperspace.<ref name="SW:XWIP">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref>

[[File:Defiancestern.jpg|thumb|left|200px|''Defiance'', viewed from the stern]]
The vessel performed numerous missions, both individually and as part of a battle line. The ''Defiance'' was commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nammo]] throughout the Galactic Civil War. Its Tactical Officer was Commander [[Devers (Rebel Alliance)|Devers]], who assumed his position following the capture and brainwashing of his predecessor, Commander [[Kupalo]].<ref name="SW:XWA" />

[[File:Defiance-concourse.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The concourse of the ''Defiance'']]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="3ABY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> the ''Defiance'' was the [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]] of a Rebel [[Defiance Task Force|task force]] stationed far from [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]],<ref name="SW:XWA" /> the Alliance headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref> during its [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|evacuation]]. With the aim of rejoining the primary [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] under Admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], the group fled from Hoth with survivors and personnel<ref name="SW:XWA" /> to a secure Rebel [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="SW:XWASG">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> The ''Defiance'', along with the [[Neutron Star-class bulk cruiser/Legends|''Neutron Star''-class bulk cruiser]] [[Diligent (Neutron Star-class)|''Diligent'']] and the [[Assault Frigate Mark I]] [[Haven (Assault Frigate)|''Haven'']], was then based at a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Lost Station]] for some time. There, Admiral Nammo granted refuge aboard the ''Defiance'' to the [[Azzameen family]], fugitives from the Empire who had followed [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Olin Garn]], a Rebel pilot and friend of [[Aeron Azzameen]]. With Garn's encouragement, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] trained as a combat pilot and enlisted in the Calamari Cruiser's starfighter complement, which included Red, Blue, and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Groups]].<ref name="SW:XWA" />

The ''Defiance'' was hunted by Imperial Admiral [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz's]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']] [[Corrupter Task Force|task force]], and served as a base for a series of operations conducted to distract and hinder the Imperial force and allow the Rebels to escape. The Calamari Cruiser's starfighters were dispatched on a diversionary [[Veltnor|convoy]] [[Destruction of the Scythe convoy|raid]] to draw the Empire's resources towards defense and away from their search, and a [[Recon on Corrupter Task Force|reconnaissance operation]] that uncovered severe damage sustained by the ''Corrupter'' at Hoth. Subsequently, the force followed an informant's lead to [[Rescue at Bundil II|liberate]] other survivors of Echo Base taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the Empire, and [[Battle of Bettel|destroyed]] a [[Corrupter repair convoy|repair team]] bound for the crippled ''Corrupter''. Finally, the ''Defiance'' group [[Battle of the Anoat Main Sensor Array|targeted]] the Imperial [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]] [[IOS 24]],<ref name="SW:XWA" /> creating a gap in the Empire's surveillance network through which Calamari Cruiser and its support ships were able to escape into the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="SW:XWASG" />

The vessel later participated in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] as rear guard to the Alliance Fleet, and pursued Imperial ships after the Rebel victory.<ref name="JKTCG">{{JKTCG|set=Masters of the Force|cardname=''Defiance''|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/mastersoftheforce/large/78defiance.html}}</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|transformation]] of the Rebel Alliance into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Nammo and the ''Defiance'' were part of the new government's [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], Nammo and the ''Defiance'' were sent by Admiral Ackbar, now of the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], to [[Battle of Bilbringi (6 ABY)|capture]] the key Imperial [[Bilbringi Shipyards|shipyards]] of [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]], but were defeated by the defending Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]] and the [[181st Imperial Fighter Wing/Legends|181st Imperial Fighter Wing]] led by [[Turr Phennir/Legends|Turr Phennir]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Defiance_insignia_SWA.jpg|200px|thumb|A hologram of the insignia of the ''Defiance'']]
The ''Defiance'' first appeared in the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']].<ref name="SW:XW" /> Issue 99 of [[Wikipedia:Computer Gaming World|''Computer Gaming World'']], released in [[October]] [[1992]], featured a preview of ''X-Wing'' which described transitions between missions taking place on the Mon Calamari Star Cruiser ''Dreadnought'' and at a Calamari space port. The ''Independence'' and the ''Defiance'' appear to take the place of these in the finished game, with the ''Defiance'' replacing the ''Dreadnought''.
